lines.zh: 发出低沉嗡鸣，向前移动。
护盾光芒增强，威胁玩家。

lines.en: The shield is up, so break it first.

lines.zh: 发出轻微振动，保持警惕。
我一层层叠起护盾，慢慢自转。
lines.en: I layer my shield and slowly spin.

lines.zh: 我悬着，像呼吸一样起伏。
lines.en: I hover, rising and falling like breath.
The light inside me brightens and dims.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙角，像盏不动的灯。
lines.en: I rest by the wall like a still lamp.

lines.zh: 我表面的细纹缓缓流动。
lines.en: Fine patterns drift across my surface.

lines.zh: 我把嗡鸣压到几乎无声。
lines.en: I lower my hum almost to silence.

lines.zh: 这层护盾，得先打穿再说。
lines.en: You must break through this shield first.
My shield still glows; you cannot pierce me.
My halo narrows until only you remain.
I turn to you; my light gathers to a point.
I study you through my shield.

lines.zh: 你的倒影在我表面晃动。
lines.en: Your reflection wavers on my surface.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我的光拖到墙角。
lines.en: My glow drags your shadow to the corner.
When you look at me, I am looking back.
Serious injury, be careful to heal.

lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，你看起来很有营养！

lines.en: Come closer, for I will consume you!
My shield cracked — feed me more energy.

lines.zh: 你的存在让我变得更强！
你就是我的下一个目标！

lines.en: Don’t try to escape, I will get you!
You’re too weak to stop me!
My shield still holds forty points.
You touched me, feel the pain!

lines.zh: 两个光球撞在一起，护盾更亮。
lines.en: Two orbs collide, and both shields flare.

lines.zh: 护盾还有四十点，一起上。
lines.en: The shield holds forty more, hit it together.

lines.zh: 靠近一步，护盾就烫你一下。
lines.en: One step closer and my shield burns you.
This shield still has forty points.

lines.zh: 这东西我吞进去，护盾又满了。
lines.en: I swallow this and my shield is whole again.

lines.zh: 你的食物已经准备好了。
我护盾里还满着，你打不穿。
lines.en: My shield is full — you cannot break through.

lines.zh: 我滚过去，把你圈进护盾里。
lines.en: I roll in and wrap you in my shield.

lines.zh: 我的视线锁上你，护盾四十点。
lines.en: My gaze locks on you, shield at forty points.

lines.zh: 你跑不出我这道光的半径。
lines.en: You can't leave the radius of my light.

lines.zh: 光点收紧，全部落在你身上。
lines.en: My light gathers into a point on you.

lines.zh: 护盾还亮着，先别急着打。
lines.en: My shield is up. Hold your fire.
I open a ring of shield for you.

lines.zh: 护盾嗡了一声，我认出你了。
lines.en: My shield hums once; I've found you.
A point of light jumps—I know you.
You carry the energy I want.
You are already inside my radius.
Hold still; I am measuring you.

lines.zh: 我贴着你转，找护甲的缝。
lines.en: I circle close, hunting a seam in your armor.
My attack will be more fatal.
I'll make you feel the pain.

lines.zh: 我一滚过去，就把你压扁。
lines.en: One roll and I flatten you.
My shield still holds forty points.
My shield's gap is meant only for you.
My core gathers brighter and brighter.
You step back; I close an inch.
I have your distance worked out.
I spin my shield like a countdown.

lines.zh: 我每嗡一声，就更近一点。
lines.en: Each hum brings me a little closer.
I noted every opening you showed.

lines.zh: 我的球心对着你的胸口。
lines.en: My core lines up with your chest.

lines.zh: 我悬着不动，护盾转得很慢。
lines.en: I hang still, shield turning slowly.

lines.zh: 我的护盾边缘开始发烫。
lines.en: My shield's rim is heating up.

lines.zh: 发出一声低沉的嗡鸣，朝你逼近。
lines.en: Buzzing low, it advances toward you.

lines.zh: 身体快速膨胀，护盾光芒大亮。
用触手缠绕你，试图击退。
lines.en: Wraps you in tentacles, trying to repel.

lines.zh: 释放电击，击打你的盔甲。

lines.en: Compresses body, aiming to knock you out.

lines.zh: 挥舞双臂，向你投掷能量球。
lines.en: Swings arms, hurling energy spheres at you.

lines.zh: 发出痛苦的嘶鸣，护盾破损。
缩小身体，准备重新充能。
用触手缠绕并撕裂敌人。
lines.en: Wraps and rips enemies with tentacles.

lines.zh: 释放大量电荷，冲击周围的方块。
lines.en: Releases massive charge, shocking surrounding blocks.

lines.zh: 我用护盾猛推，把你顶退。
lines.en: I shove with my shield and drive you back.

lines.zh: 我整个撞过去，拖着电光。
lines.en: I slam in whole, trailing sparks.

lines.zh: 我一圈能量炸开，震得你耳鸣。
lines.en: I burst a ring of energy that rings your ears.

lines.zh: 我压住你，护盾咔咔作响。
lines.en: I bear down as my shield crackles.
Flickers into existence from distant lightning.
Rises slowly from the void portal.
Appears and vanishes in the dark.

lines.zh: 被雷击激活，从地面涌出。
lines.en: Activated by lightning, surges from the ground.

lines.zh: 在天空中盘旋，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Loiters in the sky, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 被巨大的能量波动触发。
lines.en: Triggered by massive energy波动, triggered by massive energy波动.
Appears at the center of a storm.

lines.zh: 黑暗里先亮起我的一点光。
lines.en: A point of my light wakes in the dark.
I unfold from nothing into a sphere.
My hum drifts from behind the wall.
The air trembles before I appear.
A knot of light slowly becomes me.

lines.zh: 我从符文的缝隙里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a rune's seam.

lines.zh: 战场中央多了我这个光球。

lines.en: The sparks fade; I hang there.
The distant hum suddenly grows loud.

lines.zh: 我的护盾一亮，宣告我来了。
lines.en: My shield flares, announcing my arrival.
Burned by fire, hard to heal.
